title: Projective modules and locally polynomial algebras
description: Projective modules over polynomial rings and algebras that are locally polynomial. Quillen's patching theorem for extended modules and the method of Quillen induction; Horrocks' theorem, with an elementary proof over local rings; the Quillen–Suslin theorem that finitely generated projective modules over a polynomial ring over a field are free; automorphism groups of symmetric algebras, axiom Q and the factorization of an automorphism over two localizations; and the theorem of Bass, Connell and Wright that a finitely presented algebra which is locally a symmetric algebra is the symmetric algebra of a finitely presented module, so that locally polynomial algebras over k[y₁,…,y_r] are polynomial rings.

units.title: Horrocks' theorem and the Quillen–Suslin theorem

prerequisites: AG-CA lesson localization-local-properties-and-support (Theorems 2.1, 2.2, 4.2, 5.1: exactness of localization, localizing Hom out of a finitely presented module, Nakayama's lemma, local detection)
